description: This file defines the SystemUsageService class, which provides an asynchronous method GetUsageAsync to retrieve system usage metrics, including attachment counts and sizes from a database, and queue lengths from Redis.

classes.name: SystemUsageService
classes.description: A service class that aggregates system usage metrics from a database and Redis queues.

methods.name: GetUsageAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves counts and sizes of attachments from the database and queue lengths from Redis, returning an object with the aggregated data.
